messages:
Maria F.: FYI vendor FjordCloud submitted invoice INV-7782 with an early-pay discount flagged but no PO on record. attached PDF. amount $12,480. invoice date 2026-02-12.
Sanjay K.: can you drop the invoice PDF here? need the PO or the contract id to match. if no PO we have to route differently.
Maria F.: attached (INV-7782.pdf). vendor note says '2% if paid within 10 days'. no PO number on the PDF.
invoicer-bot: Invoice INV-7782 created in WorkPay (ref: wp-20260212-7782) — status: awaiting-approval.
Ellie O.: Seeing no PO in the ERP. Looks like cost_center on the invoice is `ENG-APAC-02` which our mapping doesn't recognize -> approver routing failed.
Sanjay K.: that's the root cause. procurement mapping expects `ENG-APAC` or `ENG` only. Maria, can you confirm the contract or email with procurement approval?
Maria F.: pinged procurement (Sanjay) — also asked vendor to resend any PO/quote they referenced.
Luis (FjordCloud): Hi Maria — sorry about the missing PO. We shipped under the agreed SOW (Contract CF-2025-09). We do have the quote Q-3345 that procurement accepted (email dated Jan 28). Discount terms are 2%/10 net 30. attaching quote and email thread now.
Maria F.: got the email thread from you, thanks. it references contract CF-2025-09 but there's no PO number. procurement needs to decide if they want us to create a PO post-facto.
Sanjay K.: procurement confirms they approved the SOW but did not issue a PO because this was billed against an open services contract. we need one of two things: (1) a PO created with the correct cost_center (ENG-APAC) or (2) finance can process with a manual coding override and route to the contract approver. which do you prefer, Maria?
Ellie O.: if we do (2) I'll need: contract id, approver name, and GL code. then I can manually route for payment and apply early-pay discount if vendor's terms are validated.
Maria F.: contract id = CF-2025-09 (from vendor). approver = Jordan M. (Engineering PM). GL code unknown — procurement to confirm.
Luis (FjordCloud): we can accept processing under the contract id; if that speeds things up please do. discount stands.
Sanjay K.: procurement: please confirm GL code for ENG-APAC and if Jordan M. is authorized to approve invoices against CF-2025-09.
Maria F.: procurement replied in thread: GL = 6503-services, Jordan M. ok as approver for SOWs under CF-2025-09.
Ellie O.: ok I'll create a manual routing: code override to GL 6503-services, cost_center ENG-APAC, approver Jordan M. I'll mark invoice as eligible for early-pay if payment can be scheduled within 10 days from invoice date.
invoicer-bot: Invoice INV-7782 status updated -> manual-routing-created by Ellie O.; next approver: Jordan M.
Maria F.: leaving a note: hold payment until approver signs off. if Jordan approves and payment scheduled within 10 days we should apply 2% discount.
Sanjay K.: tagging AP: once Jordan approves please queue for early-pay run and flag discount code `EPD-2P10`.
Luis (FjordCloud): thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
Maria F.: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
summary: Vendor FjordCloud invoice INV-7782 had no PO; procurement approved under contract CF-2025-09. Finance will route manually to Jordan M., apply GL 6503-services and cost_center ENG-APAC, and honor 2%/10 early-pay discount if payment scheduled within terms.
